diagnosis: The export job EXP-40128 has been running for over six hours, which matches the definition of a stalled job per kb-0005. The account is on the startup plan in us-east and entitled to data_export.
reply: Hello, and thank you for reaching out. I understand that your export job EXP-40128 has been running for nine hours. According to our guidelines, export jobs for sizes under 10 GB typically complete in under an hour, and any job that has been running for more than six hours is considered stalled. I would recommend cancelling the current job and resubmitting it. This typically resolves the issue and the new job should complete within the expected timeframe. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
